title: 憲法記念日に護憲派・改憲派それぞれは　憲法9条は「羅針盤」「ペンライト」と堅持訴え
extracted_text: 憲法改正を巡り、高市総理は2026年4月の自民党大会で「来年の党大会までに憲法改正案の発議に目途が立ったと言える状態にしたい」と明言し、改憲への強い意欲を見せています。 講演したNGOピースボートの共同代表で紛争地域を含めた世界中の人たちと交流を続ける畠山澄子さんは、身近にできることとして「まずは過去の戦争を正しく見つめること」と話します。 国際交流NGOピースボート　畠山澄子共同代表「東アジアの若者で未来を作っていくためにも、私は日本の戦争の歴史、それは加害も含めた歴史を勉強してアジアの人たちと同じ目線に立って過去と未来を見られるようになる」 集会では最後に「今こそ日本の『羅針盤』『ペンライト』である憲法9条を高く掲げ、市民と政党の熱い連帯の力で荒れ狂う波に立ち向かおう」というアピール文を採択しました。 一方、憲法改正を求める市民団体は東京で公開フォーラムを開き、憲法改正に賛成の声は高まっていて、国会でも具体的な議論を進めていくべきと訴えました。
translated_text: Regarding constitutional revision, Prime Minister (or Chief Cabinet Secretary) Takaichi clearly stated at the LDP general council in April 2026 that 'by the next year's general council, we want to be in a position where we can say there's progress toward initiating a constitutional revision proposal,' showing strong willingness toward revision. Sumiko Hatakeyama, co-representative of the NGO Peace Boat who gave a lecture and continues to interact with people from conflict zones and around the world, spoke about what can be done locally: 'First, let's properly look at the wars of the past.' Sumiko Hatakeyama, Co-Representative of Peace Boat: 'To build the future with young people in East Asia, I want to study Japan's history of war, including its role as an aggressor, so we can stand on the same perspective as Asian people and see the past and the future.' At the rally, they finally adopted an appeal statement saying: 'Now is the time to hold high Japan's 'compass' and 'beacon' - Article 9 of the constitution, and with the passionate solidarity of citizens and political parties, stand against the raging waves.' On the other hand, a civic group seeking constitutional revision held an open forum in Tokyo, where voices in favor of constitutional revision are growing, and they advocated that concrete discussions should move forward in the Diet as well.
title_en: On Constitution Day, both constitutional preservationists and revisionists assert their positions: Article 9 as a 'compass' and 'beacon'
